metadata.title: How much does the map of science depend on the embedding model? Compact reproducibility data and code
metadata.description:
Compact analysis-level reproducibility release for a study of ten document embedding models and 500,000 OpenAlex records. Includes scientific code, fixed model versions and protocols, non-text corpus metadata, exact identities and selections, per-query neighbour intersection counts, per-model/per-area/repetition measurements, geometric measurements, and recorded controls.

The public verification recalculates 25 result tables (106,445 rows), checks 17,550 local neighbour scores from intersection counts, recomputes balanced local/global agreement, and verifies the four main figure aggregations. Results match the frozen reference tables.

This route starts from frozen model-derived measurements. It does not regenerate embeddings or reconstruct nearest-neighbour lists from historical texts. Embedding shards, cached centre vectors and neighbour lists, model weights, plaintext title/abstract input tables, manuscripts and supplements are excluded. Re-querying OpenAlex may not reproduce historical text. The accompanying coverage guide states the exact tested scope; a complete rerun of every historical analysis is not claimed.

Original scientific code: MIT. Original results and documentation: CC BY 4.0. OpenAlex metadata: CC0. Scientific source snapshot cc61517dc2ea1e946c4fe391c4fcc80fa6e4819f. This compact distribution is version 1.1.0.
